# Isaiah Chapter 22 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 149r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ISA_022_page_001.jpg

---

## Consensus Translation

Isaiah 22 — key verses from the EMET literal translation

---
## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah 22 — "Oracle Against the Valley of Vision" — part of First Isaiah (chs.1-39), rooted in the 8th-century BCE Assyrian crisis. The chapter contributes to Isaiah's overarching vision: YHWH as the Holy One of Israel who judges his people but promises ultimate restoration.

---
